1. Name: HashKey Cloud
2. Networks and AuM: Validating across 42 premier protocols (including Ethereum, Solana, Cosmos, Babylon, Near, Aptos, Sui, and Polygon) with over $29B in assets under management (AuM).
3. Links: Website: https://www.hashkey.cloud/ | X: https://x.com/HashKeyCloud
4. Contact: Discord: jameswang8021 | Email: wangzezheng@hashkey.cloud | Telegram: @HashBamboo
5. Why: We are joining Gno.land as a validator to empower its pioneering developer ecosystem with HashKey Cloud's institutional-grade security. Since 2018, we’ve mastered compliant Web3 infrastructure—now, we’re ready to deliver a rock-solid, high-performance foundation for Gno.land’s Go-powered, next-gen smart contract network.
6. Contributions: Fully prepped via rigorous technical due diligence for seamless day-one onboarding, we operate battle-tested infrastructure across 42 networks. Beyond validation, we commit dedicated engineering bandwidth to build custom tooling and utilities for Gno.land. As part of HashKey Group (HKEX: 3887), we leverage deep regulatory expertise and regional leadership to drive APAC developer adoption—amplified by our media reach, social channels, and prominent presence at the annual Hong Kong Web3 Festival.
